messages.content: My best friend is getting married and I'm happy for her but also feel kind of left behind.
Honestly, both feelings can be completely true at once - happiness for her and grief for your own timeline aren't contradictory.
It feels selfish to even admit the second part.
It's not selfish, genuinely - it's human. Comparing timelines is almost automatic when something this big happens to someone close to you.
I guess I just thought we'd be at the same stage of life longer.
That's a real loss actually, even if nothing bad happened - the shape of your friendship is just shifting, and it's allowed to be a little sad while also being happy for her.
